title: Feeling behind and figuring out what to do at 29

assumptions.premise: There is a predetermined or correct purpose that a person is meant to find.
assumptions.probe: Where does the idea come from of what you are "supposed to be doing"?

assumptions.premise: Other people's external milestones mean they have achieved internal certainty.
assumptions.probe: What are we measuring when it seems everyone else has "figured it out"?

assumptions.premise: Trying multiple jobs without settling into one permanently is lost time rather than exploration.
assumptions.probe: What would have to happen for work to count as not "wasting time"?

assumptions.premise: Life has a shared schedule where people can be objectively ahead or behind.
assumptions.probe: Whose timeline are we measuring against when we feel we are "falling behind"?
